provenance.source: Kodak Professional ENDURA Transparency and Clear Display Materials datasheet E-4038 (October 2018), page 5 vector charts, digitized from embedded PDF path geometry
provenance.hd_exposure: laser exposure (characteristic-curve chart); the sheet also documents optical white-light and tricolor (WRATTEN 25/99/47B) exposure

characteristic_curves.assignment: vertical order at the common right end (logE -0.16), G above B above R, matching the printed labels; min separation 0.0958 D
characteristic_curves.exposure: laser exposure (as printed on the chart)

spectral_sensitivity.note: y labels -1.0 and 0.0 merge into the rotated axis title in text extraction; those gridlines are admitted unlabelled

spectral_dye_density.note: normalised to unit peak; yellow's maximum lies at the 400 nm end
